verdict.rationale: Meltano docs mention building custom connectors ("Build your own Meltano connector to move data from any source to any destination") and a community developer confirms the SDK experience was "absolutely top class" for building a custom tap, indicating a real official SDK exists for extractor/loader development. However, the evidence pack lacks direct documentation links to the SDK itself (e.g., API reference, versioning, language support) and no first-party SDK docs page is cited. missing for 10: dedicated SDK reference/API docs, language/version support details, more than one third-party corroboration.
